_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-04 (Steam capture 20260804154433 (art), 154708-154717 (loadout)). The page leads with the in-game class name, which is the title the loadout screen shows; the model designation rides underneath. One page covers both faction variants; both models were captured, NATO on 2026-08-04 15:43-15:48 and Pax Armata at 16:59-17:00. TBD is deliberate everywhere: a slot screen names every option in its row but describes only the highlighted one, so most options are named and not yet described. "Tactical Data Syst…" is truncated by the game's own tile label, not by us. Recorded as displayed rather than guessed at.
name: Scout Helicopter

options.name: Minigun
options.description: A rapid-fire gun for use against infantry and lightly armored vehicles.

options.name: Grenade Launcher
options.description: An automatic grenade launcher, effective at targeting infantry and unarmored targets at close range.

options.name: Heavy Rotary MG
options.description: A heavy rotary machine gun ideal for combatting unarmored vehicles and infantry at long range.

options.name: Light Rockets
options.description: Unguided rockets capable of firing larger volleys but providing less damage per projectile. Effective against light vehicles and infantry.

options.name: Aim-Guided
options.description: A rocket designed to combat infantry and light vehicles. Can be guided to the target via a weapon's crosshairs.
options.title: Aim-Guided Rockets

options.name: Smoke Launcher
options.description: Launches multiple grenades that form a cloud of smoke. Blocks ability to spot targets, and clears spotted markers from all infantry inside the smoke radius.

options.name: Motion Sensor
options.description: Dropped from the air, this device embeds in the ground where it detects and displays nearby moving enemies, vehicles, and gadgets on team members' minimaps. Enemy infantry can remain undetected while moving in crouch or prone. The device emits a sound audible to hostiles.

options.name: Stabilizer
options.title: Emergency Stabilizer
options.description: Reduces the effect of mobility hits, making it easier to stay in control of the vehicle.

options.name: Tactical Data System
options.description: Enemies spotted by the Scout Helicopter's equipment and radar will have their position marked in-world and on the minimap for all team members, not just the user's squad.

options.name: Engine Upgrade
options.description: Enables faster acceleration and top speed at the cost of maneuverability.

options.name: Interference
options.description: Slows the enemy's ability to acquire lock-on and clears the aircraft's spotted marker sooner. System deactivates if aircraft travels too slowly.
options.title: Targeting Interference

options.name: Target Designator
options.description: The designator allows users to mark both vehicles and locations. Designated targets can be locked-on from further away and lose below-radar protection.

options.name: Directional Jammer
options.description: Targets handheld and vehicle mounted enemy devices to prevent lock-on against the Scout Helicopter or other vehicles. Extended use will temporarily overheat the equipment.
